tag_policy: Page-level tags remain separate. Only explicit per-skill list entries and inline section tag prefixes are attached. Null tags mean no section-level mapping was recorded in this batch.

sections.name: Fatal Greed
sections.description_summary: Moves up to one tile and throws coins, restoring Energy to allies within 2 tiles.

sections.name: Smart Stall
sections.description_summary: Opening trolley has two health potions used automatically by nearby low-HP allies. LV 3 adds an Energy potion for a nearby ally above 600 Energy, restoring 400 Energy.

sections.name: Quack Waltz
sections.description_summary: Bradduck attacks an enemy and absorbs Energy. If health potions are depleted, later levels allow trolley replenishment.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste; grants extra Haste before the first Quack Waltz trolley replenishment.

sections.name: Great Bargain
sections.description_summary: After selling three health potions, creates a super potion that heals an ally and permanently increases Phys/Magic DEF.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Adds one opening health potion. LV 2 upgrades the Energy potion: restored Energy also grants ATK for 6 s; if Peggy is present, prepares an extra super health potion for her.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Grants an opening melee-damage buff and ranged damage reduction for the ally one tile in front; higher ranks add Energy on Hit.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Comet Archery
sections.description_summary: Fires a directional comet arrow and leaves Nebula Reflection for 7 s. Allies under the reflection summon meteors to add damage when using normal attacks.

sections.name: Empyrean Blessing
sections.description_summary: Provides an opening global ATK SPD buff for all allies and grants 120 Energy.

sections.name: Nova Fall
sections.description_summary: Meteors hit all enemies and reduce Phys DEF for 5 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Meteor Catastrophe
sections.description_summary: Opening meteors follow Lyca's normal attacks; LV 3 adds a projectile against shielded enemies, with stun if the shield breaks.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Comet Archery reduces target Phys DEF. LV 2 grants 300 Initial Energy, extends Nebula Reflection and increases allied meteor damage.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: When Lyca applies a temporary stat buff to an ally, also grants Haste for the same duration; higher ranks add damage reduction.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Dauntless Hymn
sections.description_summary: Creates a 2-tile Courage Sphere that grants Haste and Ranged DEF to allies in range. After Mikola deals sufficient damage while the sphere is active, a healing wave restores nearby allies.

sections.name: Heroic Duel
sections.description_summary: Creates a battlefield-wide Honor Arena. The side controlling more units for 3 s gains HP recovery and ATK increase for all allies.

sections.name: Vigorous Call
sections.description_summary: Heals Mikola and the two weakest allies and increases Phys/Magic DEF for 5 s.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK, with extra ATK while her side controls Honor Arena.

sections.name: Passionate Opening
sections.description_summary: After Courage Sphere has been active for 6 s, grants Combat Fury to allied heroes in range and damages adjacent enemies.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Courage Sphere duration does not expire while Mikola's side controls Honor Arena.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Healing an ally increases their ATK for 8 s; higher ranks add Healing after a cumulative-healing threshold.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a first-low-HP ally heal/shield and refine stats.

sections.name: Demonseal Spear
sections.description_summary: Sweeps the spear at enemies within 2 tiles, dealing four hits and immobilizing them; adjacent enemies are knocked back.

sections.name: Defiance Charge
sections.description_summary: Jumps next to the weakest ally and shields both, then dashes to the closest enemy and deals true damage.

sections.name: Air Strike
sections.description_summary: Performs a guaranteed critical strike against enemies one tile beyond; critical damage scales with Crit Rate.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Haste.

sections.name: Vine Arms
sections.description_summary: After Korin and allies within 2 tiles cast three Ultimates in total, empowers the spear with Wilder magic, adding max-HP-based true damage for 8 s.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken from enemies beyond 1 tile by 25%.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides a separate timed defensive/offensive effect and refine stats.

sections.name: Shapeshift
sections.description_summary: Enters Altered Form, damages and taunts enemies within 2 tiles, and gains four Spark charges. In Altered Form, two skills are enhanced and consume one Spark per use; when charges run out, Hepler returns to True Form, damaging and blinding enemies.

sections.name: Remedial Lessons
sections.description_summary: In True Form, damages an enemy and reduces Haste; in Altered Form, deals AOE damage and stuns.

sections.name: Extra Credit
sections.description_summary: In True Form, heals the weakest ally over time; in Altered Form, heals the three weakest allies and grants hardened skin/shields.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases damage reduction; grants extra damage reduction in Altered Form.

sections.name: Furry Rescue
sections.description_summary: At battle start protects the frontmost adjacent ally from the first fatal blow, heals and shields them, then transforms them into a small animal and moves them to the backline with temporary invulnerability.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Every Spark charge spent permanently increases Hepler and the protected ally's Phys/Magic DEF and reduces damage taken, stacking up to ten times.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Reduces damage taken per adjacent enemy. Higher ranks periodically damage nearby enemies and reduce their ATK.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.

source_notes: The source page locale is Polish (pl). The extraction batch contains English paraphrased summaries, not raw Polish text; no verbatim Polish description is claimed.

sections.name: Corrosive Dart
sections.description_summary: Deals damage and applies non-dispellable Dart Poison, dealing damage every second until the target is defeated. Defeating a poisoned enemy restores Energy.

sections.name: Triple Tap
sections.description_summary: Performs three attacks considered normal attacks.

sections.name: Venom Surge
sections.description_summary: Prioritizes poisoned enemies; normal attacks permanently increase Dart Poison base damage on the poisoned target, stacking up to 20.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD.

sections.name: Heart Crusher
sections.description_summary: Instantly defeats poisoned enemies below a threshold based on Dart Poison damage per second; each defeat increases the threshold.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Triple Tap deals extra damage against poisoned targets based on Dart Poison damage per second.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK SPD and normal-attack lifesteal; higher ranks add Penetration above 50% HP.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Radiant Rain
sections.description_summary: Flies and fires six volleys of three arrows at an enemy; each arrow deals ATK damage plus extra based on the target's lost HP. Aliceth is invincible while airborne.

sections.name: Guiding Light
sections.description_summary: Grants Brightfeather to an ally, prioritizing the nearest ally in her row. After three ranged hits, the ally unleashes an extra feather strike; a ranged ally also gains attack range. Active cast: a charged arrow damages, knocks back and stuns an enemy.

sections.name: Sealed Fate
sections.description_summary: Applies opening Mark of Judgment to the farthest enemy. Aliceth and Brightfeather allies prioritize that target and gain Penetration; after the condition, the mark can instantly defeat the target below an ATK-based HP threshold.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases ATK; grants extra ATK for Aliceth and Brightfeather allies after the first marked enemy is defeated or becomes untargetable.

sections.name: Aegis Wings
sections.description_summary: The first fatal blow to Aliceth or a Brightfeather ally is prevented, grants invulnerability/healing and moves the affected hero to a safe spot. LV 4 feathers cause adjacent damage over time and blind.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Every four Brightfeather feather strikes adds one extra Radiant Rain volley for the rest of battle, up to six.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Under a stationary-tile condition, after 3 s increases damage and Haste; higher ranks add shield/steadfast.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Fury Rush
sections.description_summary: Gains movement speed while moving; reaches max speed after 5 s and loads Blast Ammo. Higher ranks improve Blast Ammo damage and splash.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: Reduces Defensive Stance cooldown. LV 2: Ultimate stops time until all bullets are fired; if Blast Ammo is loaded, grants Crit DMG Boost and movement speed until controlled.

sections.name: Season Charm
sections.description_summary: Adds critical-hit splash damage; higher ranks convert part of critical damage into a permanent shield.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate normal-attack stacking effects and refine stats.

sections.name: Panic Projection
sections.description_summary: Opens the box to make all units flee toward their own side for 5 s while losing HP over time; afterward reduces ATK for 8 s, stacking up to three times. Pandora herself is protected from this effect.

sections.name: Boxed Blessing
sections.description_summary: Opening effect pulls the rearmost ally into the box, making them invincible but unable to cast skills for 4 s.

sections.name: Unfettered Carnage
sections.description_summary: An axe strike stuns the target; after 1 s, an explosion deals damage plus a bonus based on total healing Karma received since the last cast. Heals Karma per non-summoned enemy hit.

sections.name: Toxic Mosh Pit
sections.description_summary: Kar drenches himself in potions, leaving a pool that damages enemies and heals Karma; Mar swings an axe to damage nearby enemies.

sections.name: Bottled Bloodlust
sections.description_summary: Kar drinks a potion to restore HP over time; Mar performs a rapid three-hit axe attack, with a final knockdown.

sections.name: Hero Focus
sections.description_summary: Increases Vitality.

sections.name: Sanguine Growth
sections.description_summary: Max HP increases based on healing received, with a cap. At max stacks, gains Phys/Magic DEF, Resilience and larger skill ranges.

sections.name: Enhance Force
sections.description_summary: While affected by own potions, Karma takes 50% less damage; unstackable.

sections.name: Rivalry Mode
sections.description_summary: Provides separate low-HP mitigation/healing effects and refine stats.
